time_convention: t = frame / 24; frame 0 = t 0; last frame 59 = t 2.4583 s
units: pixels (x right, y down, full-resolution image coordinates) and seconds; no metric scale guessed

camera.motion: static (phase correlation of three background regions vs frame 0: shift < 0.02 px in every frame)
camera.view: looks straight down a long arched corridor, optical axis horizontal and parallel to the corridor
camera.horizon_note: VP from floor-seam Hough lines = (959, 539); fit of the man's head-top vs sole y gives horizon 533. Use 536 +- 4. Principal point is consistent with the image centre (960, 540): no pitch, no roll.
camera.camera_height_vs_man: horizon crosses the man at ~0.745 of his head-to-sole extent (upper chest): camera height ~0.75 x man's standing height above the floor
camera.focal_length: unknown; estimate from given depth_info + the man's pixel height (height_px column), see notes.md

objects.name: man
objects.description: the only person and only moving object: man in dark pinstriped long-sleeve shirt and dark trousers, seen from behind as a near-black silhouette against the bright corridor
objects.occlusion: never occluded; fully inside the frame in all 60 frames
objects.reference_point: estimated pelvis: x = centre of the hip band of the body silhouette (45-53 % down from head top), y = sole_y - 0.53 x height_px
objects.motion_summary: walks away from the camera along the corridor for the whole clip, drifting slightly to image-right; ref x 657 -> 792 px, ref y 672 -> 611 px, sole y 1052 -> 805 px; apparent height 716 -> 366 px (shrinks by factor 1.96, i.e. his camera distance roughly doubles). Never stops, steady walking gait.

objects.name: man_reflection
objects.description: mirror reflection of the man on the glossy floor directly below his feet (not a separate object; excluded from the mask)

objects.name: right_colonnade_arches
objects.description: repeating white curved arch ribs with dark rectangular pillars on the right side of the corridor; equally spaced in depth

pillar_bases_px.note: white rib x 1600-1660 + dark pillar 1660-1720, top beyond image top

objects.spacing_check: 1/(base_y - 539) = 0.00337, 0.00529, 0.00719, 0.00901, 0.01099, 0.0130: constant step ~0.0019 -> arches equally spaced along the corridor
objects.reliability: base y read by eye from a zoomed grid, +-5 px

objects.name: left_window_wall
objects.description: left side: glazed wall with white diagonal truss members and a long horizontal rail at y ~500-560 px, receding to the VP

objects.name: ceiling_ribs
objects.description: curved white ribs over a dark wooden-textured ceiling, receding to the bright corridor end

objects.name: floor
objects.description: glossy grey tiled floor with seams converging to the VP (959, 539); strong reflections

objects.name: corridor_end_opening
objects.description: over-exposed white opening at the far end of the corridor, approx x 800-1060, y 470-600

events.event: man walking already at frame 0 (no start of motion in clip)
foot contact (new stance foot lands; lowest sole point stops rising)
man reaches about the depth of the nearest right arch (sole_y ~ 835 = arch-1 base y 838)

gait: step period ~12 frames (0.5 s), stride (two steps) ~24 frames (1.0 s); earlier contact before frame 0 (sole plateau 1052 px during frames 0-4)

files.scripts/: all measurement scripts (camcheck, segment, track, overlay, overlay_track, vp, summarize, probe)
